name: DriveFlow
elevator_pitch: DriveFlow is a modern, unified vehicle rental management platform built for independent rental operators, regional agencies, and their customers. Traditional car rental operations leak revenue through fragmented spreadsheets, paper inspection forms that fail to capture pre-existing versus new vehicle damage, uncollected late return fees, and manual payment reconciliations. DriveFlow eliminates these bottlenecks with an intuitive online customer booking portal, a tablet-optimized digital inspection workflow with photo evidence and fuel/mileage tracking, and automated Stripe billing for security deposit pre-authorizations, damage claims, and overdue penalties. By centralizing the entire rental lifecycle into a single web application, DriveFlow empowers rental businesses to increase fleet utilization, cut turnaround times by 65%, and protect asset value while delivering a seamless, transparent experience for renters.
problem_statement:
Independent and mid-sized vehicle rental agencies struggle with fragmented, manual operational workflows that lead to severe revenue loss, operational friction, and customer disputes:

1. Paper-Based Inspections & Damage Disputes: Check-in and check-out condition inspections rely on paper clipboards and low-fidelity notes. When returns have dents, scratches, or missing fuel, disputes erupt because staff cannot produce time-stamped visual proof of pre-existing condition, leading to unrecovered repair costs.
2. Disconnected Payment & Deposit Handling: Security deposits and incidentals are tracked across separate terminal slips or manual card authorizations, causing failed authorizations, delayed release complaints, or lost recovery on tolls and late fees.
3. Spreadsheets & Disjointed Scheduling: Vehicle availability, maintenance schedules, and turnover cleaning are tracked in disconnected spreadsheets, resulting in double-bookings, vehicle idle time, and lower fleet utilization.
4. Unenforced Late Return & Excess Mileage Penalties: Counter staff lack automated alerts for overdue rentals, causing vehicles to stay out days past contract expiration without automated compounding fees or immediate recovery alerts.
5. Inefficient Customer Experience: Renters face lengthy counter wait times for manual document scanning, paper contracts, and manual payment processing instead of streamlined digital check-in.
solution:
DriveFlow replaces paper clipboards, disconnected card terminals, and manual spreadsheets with an integrated, tablet- and desktop-optimized web platform:

1. Digital Photo-Verified Inspections: Counter staff use tablet browsers to capture starting and ending odometer readings, fuel tank percentages, and 360-degree high-resolution photos with marked damage hotspots, establishing incontrovertible condition logs.
2. Automated Stripe Financial Pipeline: Seamlessly pre-authorizes credit card security deposits at booking or counter check-out, processes digital signatures, automatically calculates fuel/excess mileage surcharges upon check-in, and reconciles balance settlements or captures deposit claims in one click.
3. Real-Time Fleet & Reservation Management: A live fleet matrix tracks every vehicle's exact state (available, reserved, on-rent, maintenance, detailing) with automated turnaround scheduling and dynamic calendar-based availability.
4. Smart Overdue & Incident Monitoring: Automated alerts flag vehicles exceeding their scheduled return window, instantly applying configurable late return penalties, updating billing balances, and notifying both operations staff and the customer.
5. Frictionless Renter Journey: Customers enjoy a responsive web booking engine for instant reservations, transparent add-ons (insurance, GPS, child seats), digital driver's license upload, and immediate digital rental summaries.
vision: DriveFlow will evolve into the definitive operating system for independent, franchise, and commercial vehicle rental operators worldwide. Beyond core reservation and inspection workflows, the platform will expand to include connected telematics and IoT hardware integration (remote keyless lock/unlock, real-time GPS tracking, automated odometer and fuel telemetry without manual entry), AI-assisted computer vision that automatically flags newly introduced scratches or dents by comparing departure and arrival photos, and an integrated peer-to-peer and corporate B2B fleet-sharing portal. By automating the entire operational lifecycle from booking to maintenance, DriveFlow will enable operators of any size to run high-margin, dispute-free rental operations with the efficiency of modern tech-first mobility leaders.
competitors:
- HQ Rental Software: Established, feature-dense car rental ERP with strong backend accounting, but exhibits a dated user interface, steep learning curve for counter staff, and slow mobile tablet performance during physical inspections.
- Navotar: Traditional car rental software with fleet tracking and reservation modules; lacks modern real-time photo-comparison inspection flows and has rigid checkout payment customization.
- Rentyst: Cloud-based rental management platform targeted at small agencies; offers clean reservation management but has limited automated overdue penalty workflows and minimal advanced deposit claim reconciliation.
- Turo Host Tools / Commercial Host Platforms: Seamless mobile app experience for peer-to-peer sharing, but locked to Turo's marketplace, taking heavy commission percentages and lacking custom independent business rate engines, physical fleet operations tooling, and dedicated merchant account control.
success_metrics:
- Fleet Utilization Rate: Maintain average fleet utilization >= 82% across all available vehicle classes.
- Counter Check-In/Check-Out Turnaround: Reduce average customer vehicle pickup time to < 4 minutes and return inspection time to < 3 minutes.
- Damage Recovery Rate: Increase recovery of damage repair costs to >= 95% supported by time-stamped photo audit trails.
- Overdue Payment & Revenue Leakage Reduction: Reduce uncollected late return fees and unbilled fuel/mileage charges to < 1.5% of gross billings.
- Deposit Reconciliation Speed: 100% of non-disputed security deposits automatically released or reconciled within 2 hours of return inspection completion.
design_principles:
### Core Design Principles for DriveFlow

1. **Inspection Defensibility & Incontrovertible Photo Evidence**
   Every inspection touchpoint (pickup departure and check-in return) must stand up to credit card chargeback audits, legal scrutiny, and customer dispute resolution. High-resolution, multi-angle photos with immutable timestamps, geolocation tags, and visual damage pin overlays on interactive 2D vehicle silhouettes eliminate subjective disagreements. If a scratch, dent, or fuel shortfall was not photographed, pinned, and acknowledged during the walkaround, it cannot be billed. Departure photos must be displayed side-by-side with return photos to eliminate doubt.

2. **Frictionless Counter Velocity (Under 90-Second Handover)**
   Counter lines severely degrade customer satisfaction and operational efficiency. Counter agent and lot attendant workflows are architected for rapid, high-speed execution: keyboard-first navigation for desktop workstations, single-tap barcode/license scanning, and one-thumb touch targets for tablets. All primary handover steps—ID verification, Stripe deposit pre-authorization, quick condition logging, and digital agreement signing—must execute within a linear 90-second flow with zero unnecessary modals or redundant data entry.

3. **Transparent Real-Time Billing & Deposit State Visibility**
   Opaque fees and unexpected credit card charges destroy customer trust. The UI must provide unambiguous, real-time visibility into security deposit states (Pre-Authorized / Held, Released, Captured, Partially Refunded) and line-item breakdowns. Automated charges—such as fuel top-up fees, excess mileage penalties, and overdue hourly surcharges—are calculated dynamically from explicit mathematical formulas and displayed to both agent and renter before financial settlement.

4. **Role-Tailored Ergonomic Adaptation (Outdoor Lot Agility vs. Desktop Control Power)**
   Field attendants operate outdoors under direct sunlight, glare, and varying weather conditions while walking around vehicles; fleet managers analyze dense operational metrics across multi-monitor desktop setups. UI ergonomics dynamically specialize: high-contrast inspection screens with minimum 48px touch targets, camera-first triggers, offline cache resilience, and haptic feedback for lot staff, contrasted with dense multi-column grids, bulk actions, and split-screen schedule matrices for back-office administrators.

5. **Fail-Safe Operational & Financial Safeguards**
   Vehicles represent high-value mobile capital assets. DriveFlow enforces strict procedural gates: no keys may be released without an active Stripe deposit pre-authorization hold and an executed digital contract signature. The interface enforces clear linear progression (Vehicle Assignment -> Payment Authorization -> Condition Walkaround -> Electronic Signature -> Key Handover) with prominent visual warnings when exceptions occur (e.g., mismatched fuel readings or overdue return flags).

navigation_design:
### Navigation Architecture & Design Patterns

DriveFlow implements a role-partitioned, responsive navigation framework tailored to distinct operational contexts: desktop counter velocity, rugged outdoor tablet agility, and friction-free retail booking.

---

### 1. Role-Based Navigation Structures & Boundaries

#### A. Retail Renter Surface (Public & Customer Portal)
- **Top Navigation Bar (Sticky Desktop & Mobile)**:
  - Brand Logo (navigates to `/`).
  - Search / Date Selector Widget (quick-filter popup).
  - Primary Links: `Browse Fleet` (`/vehicles`), `How It Works`, `Support`.
  - Authenticated Customer Dropdown: `My Bookings` (`/account/bookings`), `Payment Methods & Billing` (`/account/billing`), `Profile & Verification` (`/account/profile`), `Log Out`.
  - Unauthenticated State: `Sign In` (`/login`) and `Create Account` (`/signup`) CTA buttons.
- **Reservation Funnel Navigation (`/booking/*`)**:
  - Horizontal progress breadcrumb: `1. Select Vehicle` -> `2. Protection & Options` (`/booking/configure`) -> `3. Review & Checkout` (`/booking/checkout`) -> `4. Confirmed` (`/booking/confirmation`).
  - Sticky reservation price drawer (docked at desktop sidebar; bottom expandable sheet on mobile) displaying itemized base rate, insurance tier, taxes, and deposit hold requirement in real time.

#### B. Counter Agent Portal (`/counter/*` and `/inspections/*`)
- **Default Landing**: `/counter/departures` (Today's Scheduled Departures).
- **Persistent Left Navigation Sidebar (Desktop 64px collapsed / 240px expanded)**:
  - `Departures Queue` (`/counter/departures`) with live counter badge (e.g., `12 Pending`).
  - `Returns Queue` (`/counter/returns`) with status badge (e.g., `4 Arrived`, `2 Overdue`).
  - `New Walkaround Inspection` (`/inspections/new`) quick-action button.
  - `Agreement Signing` (`/counter/agreement`).
  - `Settlement & Billing` (`/counter/settlement/:rentalId`).
- **Global Counter Utility Header**:
  - Global Search Input: instant auto-complete query across VIN, License Plate, Reservation #, Customer Last Name, or Phone Number (shortcut: `CMD/CTRL + K`).
  - Active Lot Location Switcher (e.g., "Airport Terminal 1 Hub").
  - Emergency Alert Bell: Real-time badge notifications for overdue returns and failed Stripe pre-authorizations.
  - User avatar with role tag ("Counter Agent") and quick lock/switch agent toggle.

#### C. Fleet Operations & Admin Portal (`/admin/*`)
- **Default Landing**: `/admin/fleet/matrix` (Live Fleet Schedule Matrix).
- **Persistent Administrative Left Sidebar (260px)**:
  - **Operations Section**:
    - `Live Fleet Matrix` (`/admin/fleet/matrix`): Gantt-style vehicle timeline.
    - `Fleet Inventory` (`/admin/fleet`): Tabular master directory with sub-link `+ Add Vehicle` (`/admin/fleet/new`).
    - `Active Rentals & Overdue` (`/admin/rentals/active`): Filterable contract list with distinct pulsating red count badge for overdue rentals (`/admin/rentals/:rentalId/overdue`).
  - **Fleet Health & Logistics**:
    - `Maintenance Hub` (`/admin/maintenance`): Service alerts with sub-link `+ New Work Order` (`/admin/maintenance/new`).
  - **Revenue & Rules**:
    - `Dynamic Pricing & Rates` (`/admin/rates`): Multi-tier seasonal and class rates.
    - `Analytics & RevPAC` (`/admin/analytics`): Utilization charts and Stripe transaction logs.
  - **System**:
    - `Branch Settings`, `Staff Access Control`, `Stripe Gateway Settings`.

---

### 2. Tablet Lot Inspection Suite Navigation Patterns (`/inspections/*`)

Lot attendants conducting outdoor walkarounds require an ergonomic, distraction-free tablet interface optimized for one-handed operation:

- **Fullscreen Focus Mode**:
  - The standard desktop left sidebar and utility header automatically collapse upon entering `/inspections/new` or `/inspections/return/:rentalId`.
  - High-contrast header displays: Vehicle License Plate, Assigned Stall #, Model Name, and an prominent "Exit Inspection" abort button with unsaved change confirmation.
- **Top Linear Step Indicator**:
  - 4-step segmented stepper: `1. Odometer & Fuel` -> `2. Exterior 360° Photos` -> `3. Pin Damage Hotspots` -> `4. Renter Sign-Off`.
- **Bottom Fixed Action Bar (Sticky 72px Ergonomic Lot Bar)**:
  - Minimum 48px touch targets designed for gloved or outdoor thumb interaction.
  - Secondary Back button (left), Ambient Flashlight / Camera Exposure toggle (center-left), Skip/Flag note (center-right), and primary high-visibility Next CTA button (e.g., `Next: Pin Blemishes ->` or `Complete & Review Agreement`).
- **Side-by-Side Inspection View (Return Inspection `/inspections/return/:rentalId`)**:
  - Split-screen comparison component: Left pane shows the timestamped departure photo taken at check-out; right pane provides the live camera viewfinder for the identical angle (Front, Driver Side, Rear, Passenger Side).
  - Tap-to-compare overlay slider with difference toggle to immediately confirm whether a bumper scratch is pre-existing or new.

---

### 3. Contextual Components, Badges & Breadcrumb Trails

- **Interactive Vehicle Status Badges**:
  - `Available / Ready`: Solid Green `#10B981` with checkmark.
  - `Reserved / Pick-Up Due`: Solid Blue `#3B82F6` with clock icon.
  - `On-Rent / Active`: Neutral Indigo `#6366F1`.
  - `Return Overdue`: Pulsating High-Visibility Red `#EF4444` with warning triangle.
  - `Turnaround / Detailing`: Warm Purple `#8B5CF6` with sparkle icon.
  - `Maintenance Hold`: Amber `#F59E0B` with wrench icon.
- **Financial & Deposit Status Badges**:
  - `Stripe Hold Active`: Emerald green pill with lock icon.
  - `Hold Expiring Soon (<24h)`: Amber pill with urgent clock.
  - `Deposit Captured`: Indigo pill with checkmark.
  - `Hold Released`: Slate gray outlined badge.
- **Breadcrumb Hierarchy**:
  - Every child view renders explicit top breadcrumbs:
    - Example 1: `Admin > Active Rentals > Overdue Management (REN-5021)`
    - Example 2: `Counter > Departures Queue > Check-Out (RES-8492)`
    - Example 3: `Admin > Maintenance > Work Orders > New Order`
  - Breadcrumb roots allow instant fallback without discarding draft state (draft walkaround photos and form inputs are cached in local browser storage).

key_features.feature_name: Online Customer Booking Engine & Account Portal
key_features.feature_description: Responsive customer-facing reservation system with real-time vehicle category and model search by date, time, and location, transparent line-item rate calculation (base rate, protection tiers, add-ons, taxes), secure Stripe checkout, and self-service booking management.

Guided check-out and check-in inspection workflow capturing odometer mileage, fuel/battery percentage, visual body-panel damage pinning, and time-stamped photo uploads with side-by-side departure versus return image comparison.

Counter agent workflow for customer identity verification, driver's license recording, automated pre-authorization of card security deposits via Stripe, electronic contract generation, and touch-screen digital signature capture.

Instant return processing that compares actual return timestamp, mileage, and fuel level against departure benchmarks. Enforces an automated refueling surcharge policy calculating missing fuel volume based on vehicle fuel tank capacity and fuel gauge variance when returned with less fuel than at departure, automatically charging a premium per-gallon rate (default $8.00 per gallon). Concurrently enforces an automated late return policy with a 60-minute (1-hour) grace period past scheduled drop-off time (vehicles returned past the 1-hour grace period automatically incur incremental hourly rate charges capped at the daily rate maximum), excess mileage fees, and automated Stripe deposit settlement or damage claim capture.

Live operations control board monitoring fleet status (available, on-rent, maintenance, cleaning), scheduled pickups, and real-time return schedules. Incorporates a 60-minute (1-hour) grace period past the scheduled drop-off time before triggering overdue rental alerts, automatically accruing hourly rate penalties (up to the daily rate maximum) on late contracts, and enabling immediate staff escalation and balance recovery.

Stripe-backed financial module managing pre-authorizations, card charges, refunds, automated invoicing, outstanding balance recovery, and flexible rate rule configuration—including vehicle class rental rates (daily, weekly, seasonal), excess mileage charges, and configurable fee schedules such as the premium per-gallon refueling rate (default $8.00 per gallon).

Comprehensive back-office operational reporting on fleet utilization percentages, revenue per available vehicle day (RevPAC), maintenance scheduling triggers based on odometer thresholds, and damage claim recovery rates.

Given existing exterior blemishes, When Marcus taps on the 2D car silhouette pin tool, Then a visual damage marker is placed with severity classification and prompts for a mandatory close-up photo.
Given missing required photos or blank odometer readings, When tapping Finish Inspection, Then the form prevents submission and highlights uncompleted walkaround sections.
Only counter_agent and fleet_manager can access /inspections/new.

user_stories.phase: Phase 1 - MVP: Operational Foundation & Revenue Capture
user_stories.title: Tablet Return Walkaround & Damage Comparison

user_story.i_want: to conduct the return walkaround comparing return condition photos side-by-side with departure photos
user_story.so_that: any new damage or scratches are immediately detected and documented with indisputable photographic evidence

acceptance_criteria: Given a counter agent at /inspections/return/:rentalId, When performing inbound inspection, Then the tablet displays original departure photos and pinned blemishes side-by-side with live return camera capture viewports.

Given newly discovered damage, When Marcus flags a new hotspot on the return vehicle wireframe, Then the system marks it as 'New Damage' and mandates at least one photo with damage description and dimensions.

Given an inbound vehicle return, When the agent records return odometer reading and fuel percentage, Then the system automatically calculates mileage delta and fuel variance against departure records.
Only counter_agent and fleet_manager can access /inspections/return/:rentalId.

user_stories.phase: Phase 1 - MVP: Operational Foundation & Revenue Capture
user_stories.title: Deposit Settlement, Capture & Release

user_story.i_want: to settle the Stripe deposit hold by capturing assessed surcharge balances and releasing the remaining amount immediately
user_story.so_that: renters receive an instantaneous itemized final invoice and deposit release notification

acceptance_criteria: Given an itemized return balance at /counter/settlement/:rentalId where no surcharges or damage are owed, When Marcus clicks Release Deposit, Then DriveFlow issues an immediate Stripe API release call for the full deposit hold.

Given return charges (e.g., refueling fee), When Marcus clicks Capture Charges & Release Difference, Then DriveFlow captures the charges from the pre-authorization hold and releases remaining funds via Stripe in a single atomic transaction.
Given total charges exceeding deposit hold amount, When settled, Then the entire deposit is captured and an invoice for remaining balance owed is generated and flagged for balance recovery.

Given settlement completion, When final charges commit, Then vehicle status transitions to 'Cleaning/Turnaround', and an itemized digital receipt PDF is dispatched to the customer's email and account portal.
Only counter_agent and fleet_manager can execute deposit settlement on /counter/settlement/:rentalId.

user_stories.title: Fleet Status Matrix & Vehicle Onboarding

user_story.i_want: to view an interactive timeline matrix of all fleet assets and onboard new vehicles with VIN, registration, and initial mileage
user_story.so_that: I maintain real-time visibility over asset turnaround and dispatch readiness across the facility

acceptance_criteria: Given Elena at /admin/fleet/matrix, When viewing the schedule board, Then all fleet vehicles are displayed in an interactive timeline categorized by status (Available, On-Rent, Maintenance, Detailing) across chosen date ranges.
Given Elena at /admin/fleet/new, When adding a new fleet asset, Then the form requires VIN, license plate, make, model, model year, vehicle category, and initial odometer mileage.
The app provides an upload UI for vehicle registration documentation data, accepting PDF, PNG, and JPG, and visibly confirms a successful import.
Only fleet_manager can access /admin/fleet, /admin/fleet/new, and /admin/fleet/matrix.
Given an attempt to register a duplicate VIN or license plate, When clicking save, Then the system alerts Elena with a duplicate conflict error and halts creation.

user_stories.title: Balance Recovery & Customer Invoicing

user_story.i_want: to track uncollected post-rental balances, trigger secondary Stripe payment captures, and generate downloadable tax invoices
user_story.so_that: the business recovers overdue accounts receivable and provides complete financial transparency

acceptance_criteria: Given a rental where final settlement charges exceeded the security deposit hold, When Elena views the uncollected accounts list, Then the system highlights the delinquent amount and links the customer's on-file Stripe customer token.
Given an outstanding balance owed, When Elena executes Charge Balance to Card, Then DriveFlow submits a direct payment intent via Stripe API and logs the transaction receipt.
Given an authenticated customer at /account/billing, When reviewing completed rentals, Then the customer can view itemized payment histories and download PDF receipts with Stripe reference numbers.
Unauthenticated users are redirected to /login when accessing /account/billing.
Only fleet_manager can access /admin/rates and back-office billing reconciliation tools.

user_stories.title: Odometer Service Triggers & Maintenance Scheduling

user_story.i_want: to monitor mileage thresholds and auto-flag vehicles needing oil changes, brake inspections, or tire rotations into maintenance work orders
user_story.so_that: fleet safety is guaranteed, asset lifespans are maximized, and unserviced cars are never dispatched to renters

acceptance_criteria: Given Elena at /admin/maintenance, When checking vehicle service statuses, Then the dashboard automatically flags any vehicle whose odometer exceeds service intervals with a high-priority Service Due badge.
Given a flagged vehicle, When Elena clicks Create Work Order at /admin/maintenance/new, Then the form captures vendor name, estimated cost, expected completion ETA, and service category.

Given submission of an active work order, When confirmed, Then the vehicle operational status automatically shifts from 'Available' to 'Maintenance', removing it from front-desk pickup allocation and online booking availability.
Given maintenance completion, When Elena enters the final vendor invoice and records new service mileage, Then vehicle status transitions back to Available.
Only fleet_manager can access /admin/maintenance and /admin/maintenance/new.
The data model stores cleanliness status and the application uses it as described in this story.

user_stories.title: Executive Operational & Financial Analytics

user_story.i_want: to review executive dashboards tracking daily fleet utilization %, RevPAC, unrecovered damage claims, and deposit reconciliations
user_story.so_that: I can make data-driven decisions on fleet resizing, rate optimizations, and operational cost controls

acceptance_criteria: Given Elena at /admin/analytics, When selecting a reporting timeframe (e.g. trailing 7, 30, or 90 days), Then the dashboard calculates and charts Fleet Utilization Rate and RevPAC across vehicle classes.

Given the financial reconciliation widget, When auditing deposit performance, Then DriveFlow displays aggregated metrics for total security deposits held, deposits released in full, partial captures, and uncollected damage claims.
Given the maintenance analytics breakdown, When reviewed, Then total maintenance expenditures and average vehicle downtime days are charted per vehicle class.
Only fleet_manager can access /admin/analytics.
Unauthenticated users are redirected to /login when accessing /admin/analytics.

user_stories.title: Active Rentals Monitoring & Overdue Detection

user_story.i_want: to monitor all active rental agreements in real time and immediately identify contracts exceeding scheduled return deadlines
user_story.so_that: our operations team can take immediate recovery action before vehicle loss or unbilled usage escalates

acceptance_criteria: Given Elena at /admin/rentals/active, When filtering contracts by status, Then the list provides filter toggles for Active, Due Today, and Overdue with elapsed overdue time counters.

Given a rental exceeding its scheduled return time by more than 1 hour (60 minutes) without an extension, When the 1-hour grace period expires, Then the system automatically transitions the rental status to 'Overdue' and triggers high-priority warning alerts on the active rentals hub.
Only fleet_manager can access /admin/rentals/active and /admin/rentals/:rentalId/overdue.

Given an active rental where the customer requests an extension, When Elena approves new return dates with available fleet buffers, Then the system recalculates rental duration, confirms additional payment, and clears overdue warnings.

user_stories.title: Overdue Escalation & Deposit Pre-Auth Expansion

user_story.i_want: to review overdue rental details, dispatch automated urgency notices via SMS/email, and expand Stripe pre-authorization holds
user_story.so_that: we protect agency revenue exposure and encourage rapid return of delinquent vehicles

acceptance_criteria: Given Elena at /admin/rentals/:rentalId/overdue, When opening a flagged rental, Then the console displays contracted return time, the 1-hour (60-minute) grace period expiration timestamp, and calculated incremental hourly late fees capped at the vehicle's standard daily rate.

Given an overdue rental record, When Elena clicks Send Return Urgency Notice, Then the system dispatches an automated SMS and email notification to the renter containing current late penalty totals and return instructions.

Given unreturned status extending beyond designated threshold, When Elena triggers Expand Pre-Authorization Hold, Then DriveFlow initiates an incremental Stripe pre-authorization charge against the customer's on-file credit card.
Given a card decline during pre-auth expansion, When Stripe responds with an error, Then the system logs the failed charge attempt and prompts Elena to flag the asset for recovery escalation.
Only fleet_manager can access /admin/rentals/:rentalId/overdue.

user_stories.phase: Phase 1 - MVP: Operational Foundation & Revenue Capture
user_stories.title: Automated Surcharge Calculation on Return

user_story.i_want: the system to automatically calculate refueling deficits, excess mileage charges, and late return penalties upon check-in
user_story.so_that: settlement billing is 100% accurate without manual math errors or counter delays

acceptance_criteria: Given a vehicle return at /counter/returns, When the agent enters license plate or scans agreement QR code, Then the active rental record is loaded with scheduled return time, departure fuel, and mileage cap allowances.

Given return inspection data submitted at /counter/settlement/:rentalId, When fuel level is lower than departure level at /counter/settlement/:rentalId, Then the system calculates the missing volume in gallons using vehicle tank capacity and fuel percentage variance, multiplying by the configured premium per-gallon rate (default $8.00/gal) to apply an itemized refueling surcharge.
Given return mileage exceeding contracted allowance, When calculated, Then excess miles are multiplied by the contracted per-mile rate and added as an explicit line item.

Given a vehicle returned past scheduled return time and the 1-hour (60-minute) grace period, When processed, Then the system calculates incremental hourly rate late fees billed up to the vehicle's standard daily rate cap per rental agreement terms.
Only counter_agent and fleet_manager can access /counter/settlement/:rentalId and /counter/returns.
The data model stores dropoff location code and the application uses it as described in this story.
The data model stores actual return datetime and the application uses it as described in this story.

user_stories.title: Dynamic Pricing Rules & Seasonal Multipliers

user_story.i_want: to configure base daily rates, weekend surge multipliers, seasonal date ranges, and vehicle class rate cards
user_story.so_that: we maximize rental revenue during peak demand periods while maintaining competitive pricing

acceptance_criteria: Given Elena at /admin/rates, When creating or updating a pricing rule, Then she can specify vehicle category, base daily rate, weekly discount percentage, and excess mileage fee per unit.

Given active seasonal periods (e.g. holiday weekends, summer peak), When Elena defines date ranges and percentage surge multipliers, Then vehicle rates on /vehicles and /booking automatically adjust accordingly.

Given Elena at /admin/rates, When configuring fee schedules alongside standard rates, Then she can configure and update the premium refueling rate per gallon (default $8.00/gal) applied to vehicle refueling shortfalls.
Given an attempt to set negative rates or end dates preceding start dates, When Elena clicks save, Then the system displays validation errors and blocks rule creation.
Only fleet_manager can access /admin/rates.
The data model stores unit price and the application uses it as described in this story.

target_audience.name: Counter Agent
pain_points: Time-consuming paperwork causing counter queues
Customer arguments over pre-existing vehicle scratches and dents
Manual math errors calculating fuel top-up and excess mileage fees
Clunky software requiring multiple windows for payments and reservations
target_audience.demographics: Front-desk rental representatives and field lot attendants operating on desktop workstations and tablet browsers at rental facilities.
needs_and_goals: Rapid customer check-in and check-out turnaround
Foolproof tablet vehicle inspection with photo logging
Instant driver license verification and contract signature
Clear view of today's arrivals, departures, and vehicle readiness

target_audience.name: Fleet Operations Manager
pain_points: Revenue leakage from uncollected damage and unbilled late return hours
Spreadsheet errors leading to double-bookings and idle vehicles
Complex deposit reconciliation and chargeback exposure
Lack of centralized operational visibility across multiple locations
target_audience.demographics: Operations directors, fleet supervisors, and business administrators managing inventory, pricing, asset protection, and financial reconciliation.
needs_and_goals: Maximize fleet utilization rates and vehicle revenue per day
Automated tracking of overdue vehicles and late fee recovery
Comprehensive maintenance logs and scheduled service reminders
Accurate reporting on revenue, deposits held, and unpaid customer balances

target_audience.name: Retail Renter
pain_points: Surprise charges at the counter for insurance, fuel, or minor scratches
Long counter queues after long flights or urgent transit needs
Delayed or unexplained security deposit holds on credit cards
Opaque return procedures with no immediate receipt or inspection sign-off
target_audience.demographics: Leisure travelers, local replacement renters, and corporate business travelers seeking quick, transparent vehicle rentals.
needs_and_goals: Frictionless vehicle browsing and clear upfront pricing without hidden fees
Fast pickup process without long lines or redundant document presentation
Transparent condition reports to ensure no unjust damage charges
Prompt release of security deposits following vehicle return

steps.description: Marcus opens /counter/departures on his counter workstation, selects David Chen's scheduled reservation, and reviews vehicle allocation.
Navigates to /counter/check-out/RES-8492, verifies David's government ID and driver's license details, and executes the Stripe credit card security deposit pre-authorization hold.
Picks up the lot tablet, navigates to /inspections/new, scans the vehicle barcode on lot bay 14, and inputs current odometer (14,250 mi) and fuel level (100%).

Conducts the 360-degree walkaround with David, captures 4 required exterior photos, tags a pre-existing 2-inch paint chip on the rear bumper using the 2D car silhouette pin tool, and snaps a close-up photo.
Opens /counter/agreement on the tablet, presents the terms, and prompts David to review the pinned condition and sign digitally on the touch screen.
Finalizes check-out; system marks vehicle status to 'rented', generates an encrypted PDF rental agreement, and hands keys to David in under 90 seconds.

user_journeys.context: Marcus Vance processes a scheduled customer check-out during the morning rush, conducting a quick tablet walkaround, pinning pre-existing scratches, and executing an electronic contract.
user_journeys.trigger: Customer arrives at rental counter desk for scheduled morning vehicle pickup.

steps.description: Elena views /admin/fleet/matrix and /admin/rentals/active, filtering by status 'Overdue' to pinpoint vehicle classes and customer accounts in breach.
Drills into /admin/rentals/REN-5021/overdue, where DriveFlow displays contract return deadline (10:00 AM), 30-minute grace period expiry, and automated $75/hr late penalty calculations.
Reviews customer contact attempts, clicks 'Send Return Urgency Notice' via automated SMS/email, and triggers an incremental $250 Stripe pre-authorization hold to protect agency exposure.
Navigates to /admin/maintenance to review odometer service thresholds, noting two returned sedans requiring 15k-mile oil changes, and generates work orders at /admin/maintenance/new.
Accesses /admin/analytics to audit daily RevPAC, fleet utilization rate (91.4%), and total security deposits currently held versus captured.

user_journeys.context: Elena Rostova monitors active fleet operations, identifies vehicles exceeding return deadlines, applies late penalties, orders preventative maintenance, and reviews financial metrics.
user_journeys.trigger: Automated operations alert flags a vehicle 90 minutes past scheduled return time without an authorized extension.

steps.description: David visits /vehicles, enters pickup/drop-off dates and city location, compares vehicle classes, and filters for 'Executive Sedan'.
Proceeds to /booking/configure, selects Premium Roadside Protection and toll pass add-on, reviewing clear line-item totals with zero hidden fees.
Navigates to /booking/checkout, enters personal details, uploads his driver's license image, and authorizes the reservation payment via integrated Stripe Elements.
Receives instant confirmation voucher with QR code at /booking/confirmation, and checks his reservation record at /account/bookings.
Arrives at rental desk, verifies ID with Marcus, reviews pre-existing blemish photos on the tablet at /counter/agreement, and executes e-signature.

Returns vehicle to lot at /counter/returns; Marcus inspects vehicle at /inspections/return/REN-8492, confirms zero new damage and full fuel tank, and triggers settlement at /counter/settlement/REN-8492.
David receives an instant digital receipt and Stripe notification that his $300 security deposit hold has been released in full.

user_journeys.context: David Chen books a premium sedan online, completes fast lot pickup, and experiences transparent return inspection with immediate deposit release.
user_journeys.trigger: David needs to secure a rental vehicle for an upcoming out-of-town business roadshow.

features: Online Customer Booking Engine & Account Portal
phasing.rationale: Establishes the core transactional backbone for DriveFlow: public vehicle discovery and online reservation booking, counter check-out with driver verification and digital contract execution, tablet-guided walkaround inspections with photo evidence, and return check-in with automated surcharge calculation and security deposit settlement.
phasing.phase_name: Phase 1 - MVP: Operational Foundation & Revenue Capture

phasing.rationale: Empowers fleet operators with centralized visibility over real-time vehicle dispatch, status lifecycles, proactive overdue return monitoring, automated renter notifications, and accelerated turnaround management to maximize operational velocity and minimize asset loss.

Delivers enterprise-grade scaling through dynamic demand-based rate rules, advanced automated payment reconciliation and balance collection, preventative maintenance lifecycle tracking triggered by odometer thresholds, and executive RevPAC and fleet utilization analytics.
